runtime: GHC base library (compiled; the function-type rule covers arrow and action types from the hover type)
conventions: Symbols are module-qualified (Control.Monad.sequence_). An argument of an arrow type, of IO a, or of m a where m has a Functor/Applicative/Monad class constraint may be run (function-type rule); rows cover only containers of actions.

entries.describe: sequence_ actions runs every action of the container in order
entries.why: base ships compiled; the container type t (m a) is not an action or arrow type, so the function-type rule does not see that the elements run

ffi_conventions.describe: the declared Haskell function calls the C symbol name
the Haskell function is exported to C as name

test_conventions.describe: hspec-discover collects the spec of every *Spec.hs module under the test directory
